title: Rucksack Reorganization
description: Find misplaced items and group badges using set intersections.
writeup:
## Approach

Use set intersection to find shared characters. Priority: `a`–`z` → 1–26, `A`–`Z` → 27–52.

## Part 1

Split each rucksack in half. The intersection of the two halves gives the misplaced item. Sum priorities.

## Part 2

Group rucksacks in threes. The intersection of all three sets in each group gives the badge. Sum priorities.
